title: Missing error boundary around section components
reasoning: If any section component (WelcomeSection, AboutYouSection, MarkChatSection, DocumentsSection) throws an error, the entire portal will crash with a white screen. No error boundary is present to catch and display a fallback UI. This is a poor user experience and prevents partial recovery.
reproduction:
1. Simulate an error in any section component (e.g., null reference)
2. Navigate to that section
3. Observe entire app crashes, user cannot navigate away
recommendation: Wrap section rendering in a React ErrorBoundary component. On error, display a fallback message and allow navigation to other sections. Log errors for debugging.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests exist. Error boundary coverage requires integration tests that simulate component errors and assert fallback UI renders.
suggestedRegressionTest: Integration test: mock a section component to throw an error, assert ErrorBoundary fallback UI renders and other sections remain accessible.
minimumFixScope: LindsayPortal.tsx main content area (both mobile and desktop layouts) + new ErrorBoundary component
